title: Monotonicity of the miss probability
statement: Let $G$ be a finite regular multigraph of degree $D>0$, and fix vertices $t$ and $s$. The probability that a length-$k$ sequence of uniformly chosen neighbor slots, started at $s$, fails to visit $t$ is nonincreasing as $k$ increases.
